title: Copper Tools by Franstyk
description: This mod adds copper tools, in future, i may add armor and copper pickaxe. Tools effinency is beetwen stone tools and iron tools.
body:
Created by _Franstyk_

**Description:**
This mod adds tools made from copper: Axe, Sword, Hoe, Shovel. More of tools and armor will be added in future versions.
